openingLine: I am done. Timur replaced my module without even asking me, and I am thinking of leaving the team.

turns.text: Timur shouldn't have done that, I'll talk to him.
turns.characterLine: I appreciate that, but I do not want this to become a fight. How will we talk with him fairly?

turns.text: Let's sit down with Timur, all three of us.
turns.characterLine: I will join if you lead the conversation. We still need a decision: which version stays, and who owns each fix?

turns.text: We'll figure it out as we go.
turns.characterLine: That is still unclear. What exactly should I do today? The Thursday run has already failed.

turns.text: We cut scope and move on.
turns.characterLine: All right, we can cut scope. I am tired, but I will help finish the smaller demo.
